snippet.title: D.Mon | New Hero Gameplay Trailer | Overwatch
snippet.description:
Get ready for a Hero of MEKA proportions with the arrival of D.Mon!

Former pro gamer Yuna Lee finally joins the roster as our newest Tank Hero. Piloting her mech, Beast, D.Mon slices through her enemies up close with her Plasma Saber and defends her team using her Power Barrier.

Activate her Propulsors to quickly maneuver the battlefield, fire up her Fusion Repeater for added pressure on the enemy team, and set your team up for success when you unleash her Ultimate, Limit Break.

Similar to D.Va, you’ll also be able to eject from D.Mon’s mech when you’ve taken too much damage and call it back when you’re ready for the next team fight.

Suit up and take charge when Season 4: Heroes of Busan launches on Aug 11.

Overwatch is free to play on PC and console, now including Nintendo Switch™ 2"!
_

snippet.title: I Caught Every Shiny Pokemon Before Each Rank (Legends ZA)
snippet.description:
After obtaining the Shiny Charm in my first playthrough of Pokémon Legends: Z-A, I immediately learned that shiny hunting didn't really feel as special as it used to when I was younger. I wanted every shiny Pokémon to feel special, so I started a new save file with the goal of getting every Shiny Pokémon before ranking up in the Z-A royale, which became the longest adventure I've ever gone on.

This video is dedicated to my Mom. Without you, I wouldn't be the person that I am today.

snippet.title: THE ONLY LIVING PICKPOCKET IN NEW YORK | Official Trailer (2026)
snippet.description:
A love-letter to New York City. Watch the official trailer for THE ONLY LIVING PICKPOCKET IN NEW YORK. 

Opens in NY & LA theaters October 23, nationwide October 30. 

Directed by: Noah Segan
Starring: John Turturro, Giancarlo Esposito, Will Price, Tatiana Maslany, Victoria Moroles, Steve Buscemi, and Jamie Lee Curtis

Harry Lehman (John Turturro) is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily canceled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.

snippet.title: Quake: Dawn of the Machine — Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Quake™: Dawn of the Machine is available now!  

To celebrate Quake’s 30th anniversary, the award-winning team at MachineGames—in collaboration with id Software—returns with Dawn of the Machine, a brutal new episode building on their critically acclaimed work on Dimension of the Machine and Dimension of the Past. Delivering ferocious combat, labyrinthine level design, and nightmarish realms that twist reality beyond recognition, it pushes the legacy of the genre-defining first-person shooter even further, honoring one of gaming’s most enduring icons.  

  

END THE NIGHTMARE. ESCAPE THE ILLUSION  

Ranger is trapped in a dimension of endless illusion, reliving the same violent cycles for what feels like lifetimes, dying thousands of times in a futile attempt to escape. Wearied but unbroken, he has heard rumor of The Nightmare Machine.   

Beyond the hordes of monsters, twisted by an eternity in the Elder realms, lies the Machine. It is believed its destruction will shatter the illusion, finally breaking the loop.

About Darkoo:
Nigerian-born and London-raised, Darkoo’s love for music was nourished within her family home where the sounds of 9ice and D’banj, alongside Fela Kuti and Ebenezer Obey could be heard resonating around the house.  A self-confessed ‘Afro-head’, Nigerian superstars such as Wande Coal and Wizkid left a lasting impact on Darkoo, particularly after she moved to London around the age of seven. 

In 2019 Darkoo released her stand-out track, 'Gangsta' featuring fellow Londoner and rapper One Acen. Featuring her signature deep husky vocals, the track shot the teenager to fame, quickly becoming a TikTok favourite and was crowned the biggest Afrobeat Song of 2020 and earning her three MOBO nominations. 
Fast forward to 2024 and Darkoo’s viral hit ‘Favourite Girl’ earned her global critical acclaim, in addition to a two MOBO wins for song of the year and female artist of the year

snippet.title: 劇場シリーズ【第一部】メイドインアビス 目覚める神秘｜本予告
snippet.description:
『劇場シリーズ【第一部】メイドインアビス 目覚める神秘 』
2026年10月23日（金）公開！

ムビチケカード販売中！
https://miabyss.com/movie_part1/ticket.html

＜イントロダクション＞
隅々まで探索されつくした世界に、唯一残された秘境の大穴『アビス』。
どこまで続くとも知れない深く巨大なその縦穴には、奇妙奇怪な生物たちが生息し、
今の人類では作りえない貴重な遺物が眠っている。
「アビス」の不可思議に満ちた姿は人々を魅了し、冒険へと駆り立てた。
そうして幾度も大穴に挑戦する冒険者たちは、次第に『探窟家』と呼ばれるようになっていった。
アビスの縁に築かれた街『オース』に暮らす孤児のリコは、いつか母のような偉大な探窟家になり、アビスの謎を解き明かすことを夢見ていた。
ある日、母・ライザの白笛が発見されたことをきっかけに、アビスの奥深くへ潜ることを決意するリコ。リコに拾われた記憶喪失のロボット・レグも自分の記憶を探しに一緒に行くことを決意する。
深界四層で猛獣タマウガチの毒に苦しむリコ。リコを救ったのは成れ果てのナナチだった。ナナチを仲間に加え、ボンドルドの待つ深界五層へと三人は冒険を進める。
そこで、出会ったプルシュカと名乗る女の子は、ボンドルドに育てられ外界を知らずにいた。
リコの冒険話に夢中になり一緒に冒険に行きたいと願うが、あえなくボンドルドの実験に利用されてしまう。
しかし、プルシュカは形を変えリコの白笛となり、一同は深界六層「還らずの都」へと進む。
そこには、成れ果てが独自の価値観を持って生活している「成れ果ての村」と、姫・ファプタが存在していた。ファプタの「願い」によって解放された村は崩壊し、リコたちはファプタを誘い、深界七層へと進むのであった。

＜スタッフ＞
原作：つくしあきひと（竹書房「竹コミ！」）
監督：小島正幸
脚本：倉田英之
キャラクターデザイン：黒田結花、黄瀬和哉（ProductionI.G）
デザインリーダー：高倉武史
美術監督：増山 修・関口 輝・中村朝咲（インスパイアード）
色彩設計：山下宮緒
撮影監督：江間常高（T2 studio）
編集：黒澤雅之
音響監督：山田 陽
音響効果：野口 透
音楽：Kevin Penkin
音楽プロデューサー：飯島弘光
音楽制作：IRMA LA DOUCE
音楽制作協力：KADOKAWA
アニメーション制作：キネマシトラス
製作：劇場シリーズ「メイドインアビス」製作委員会

主題歌：「Chain of the Abyss」
Kevin Penkin feat. Mori Calliope
作詞: Kevin Penkin, Mori Calliope
作編曲: Kevin Penkin

＜キャスト＞
リコ：富田美憂
レグ：伊瀬茉莉也
ナナチ：井澤詩織
ファプタ：久野美咲
テパステ：諸星すみれ
クラヴァリ：星野貴紀

しかし、プルシュカは形を変えリコの白笛となり、一同は深界六層「還らずの都」へと進む。
そこには、成れ果てが独自の価値観を持って生活している「成れ果ての村」と、姫・ファプタが存在していた。ファプタの「願い」によって解放された村は崩壊し、リコたちはファプタを誘い、深界七層へと進むのであった。

snippet.description:
Fleetwood Mac - Go Your Own Way (Lyric Video)

🔔 Subscribe to Liquid Bop channel: https://bit.ly/4kwAcc7

Fleetwood Mac remains one of the most commercially successful and influential groups in the history of popular music. Formed in London in 1967, the band evolved through several iterations before solidifying the lineup responsible for their global dominance: Lindsey Buckingham (guitar, vocals), Stevie Nicks (vocals), Christine McVie (keyboards, vocals), John McVie (bass), and Mick Fleetwood (drums). Their 1977 album *Rumours* stands as one of the best-selling records ever, having moved over 40 million copies worldwide and earning multiple Grammy Awards.

The group defined the sound of the late 1970s through a combination of intricate vocal harmonies, polished production, and driving rhythm sections. Their work bridged the gap between blues-rock roots and the melodic sensibilities of pop, influencing generations of songwriters and producers. Beyond *Rumours*, the band achieved massive success with albums like *Fleetwood Mac* and *Tusk*, securing their place in the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame and maintaining consistent radio airplay for over five decades.

This video presents the official lyrics for "Go Your Own Way," a standout track from the *Rumours* sessions that captures the tension and creative energy within the band during its recording. The song remains a staple of classic rock radio and continues to reach new audiences through digital streaming and film placements. Follow the lyrics on screen and sing along to this definitive track from the Fleetwood Mac catalog.

snippet.title: Voidwest - CLOSER THAN THE NIGHT (Official Audio) | Dark Country Blues x Melodic Techno
snippet.description:
"CLOSER THAN THE NIGHT" — Dark Country Blues x Melodic Techno
A deeply emotional, hypnotic fusion of Dark Country Blues and Melodic Techno at 122 BPM. Featuring a deep, gravelly male vocal with bluesy phrasing, raw fingerpicked acoustic guitar, weeping slide guitar, and a rolling, warm melodic sub-bass. A cinematic journey through intimate moments, sleepless nights, and the feeling of being closer than the night itself.

✍️ Use this music in your videos, edits, and projects — tag @voidwestmusic to be featured!

snippet.title: Dax - "Happy Wife, Happy Life" (Official Music Video)
snippet.description:
[LYRICS BELOW] Do you believe in the phrase "Happy Wife, Happy Life?" Let's discuss. I'm praying this reaches those who need it and creates an honest discussion.

The Anger Management Tour starts Sep. 11th CLICK HERE FOR TICKETS:
https://daxofficial.com/tour



Click here to listen: 
https://dax.lnk.to/AngerManagement



Follow DAX: @thatsdax
Shot by: Logan Meis
Produced by: Lex Nour Beats

#HappyWifeHappyLife #dax #marriage #husband #wife #husbandwife 

LYRICS:

I gave you flowers 
but you never planted seeds
I give you time and spend it 
you think that it’s free
I gave you diamonds 
with a wedding and a ring
you fell in love with them
And never really married me
Your rainbow never leads to a pot of gold
No point of getting you a house
If you can’t turn it to a home
I’m tired of getting everything you want
I’m breaking free
I can’t give you what you want
But I can give you what you need

Unrealistic expectations
is what you have 
and what I’m done chasing 
you play your cards 
I grant you patience
You showed your hand
And now I’m done waiting
You always cry when I don’t buy
Your fireworks are like the Fourth of July
I gave you wings and now you fly
And claim I changed and I’m not your type
Fool me once if you do it again
I’ll pay the price with common sense
Your thin ice pushed me right to the edge
Girl this ain’t love if there ain’t no respect

I gave you flowers 
but you never planted seeds
I give you time and spend it 
you think that it’s free
I gave you diamonds 
with a wedding and a ring
you fell in love with them
And never really married me
Your rainbow never leads to a pot of gold
No point of getting you a house
If you can’t turn it to a home
I’m tired of getting everything you want
I’m breaking free
I can’t give you what you want
But I can give you what you need

No more shopping sprees 
or spa trips with your friends 
no more swiping my card 
watching Hollywood stars 
trying to keep up with all of the trends
no more male friends 
I can’t stand those guys 
who fake and try to pretend 
like they wouldn’t touch on ya
if given the chance 
to take my place and get you out your pants
I’m praying for us 
to make it through rainy days
I made a vow 
my commitment will never change 
a happy life is a choice that you gotta make 
cause happiness comes from giving 
not what you take 
don’t wanna hurt you 
just need you to understand 
that picture perfect life they’re posting 
is fake on your Instagram 
stop buying tickets to their circus 
comparing what you’re worth is
I’m breaking these chains 
off my feet and chasing purpose

I gave you flowers 
but you never planted seeds
I give you time and spend it 
you think that it’s free
I gave you diamonds 
with a wedding and a ring
you fell in love with them
And never really married me
Your rainbow never leads to a pot of gold
No point of getting you a house
If you can’t turn it to a home
I’m tired of getting everything you want
I’m breaking free
I can’t give you what you want
But I can give you what you need


_________________________________________________________________

SHOUT OUT to anyone who made it this far in the description. You are a real one. I truly believe this song will make an IMPACT as time passes and speak for those who can't seem to come up with the right words. The relationship between a man and a woman in the most important thing in the world by default due to the fact it is what creates life. I'm the lines of communication between the two is one of my over arching goals. This song is another brick laid and I want to thank anyone who takes the time to like, comment, and most importantly SHARE! This is and will always be music for the people, spread BY THE PEOPLE. Love you all and please take the time to check out the full ALBUM "Anger Management".

snippet.title: G2 vs LOUD - VCT Americas Stage 2 - Week 4 Day 2
snippet.description:
Widely regarded as the most successful region in international VALORANT competition, VCT Americas is home to world-class talent, championship-winning veterans, and the latest generation of emerging stars. The region also boasts the reigning Masters London champions and the current VALORANT Champions winners.
Now, the stakes are higher than ever. Every team enters Stage 2 with one objective: secure a spot at VALORANT Champions Shanghai.
Leviatán enters Stage 2 riding high after its Masters London triumph. NRG is ready to remind the world why it has long been considered a global powerhouse. Meanwhile, G2 Esports aims to defend its VCT Americas crown and add another championship to its trophy case.
We’re proud to work with our fantastic partners throughout 2026: ExpressVPN, HP, Pulsar, Red Bull, Samsung, Secretlab, Verizon, and Zowie.

snippet.title: The hunt for Runescape's most elusive animal
snippet.description:
Forge Day PC Sale is Now Live! Starforge's Largest Sale of the Year! https://starforgepc.com/AlienFood #ad

Welcome to Unguided, where I'm trying to complete every quest in old school runescape without using a guide, wiki or plugins. I'll only be using my limited knowledge and in-game learnings. Full rules below.

Watch the full Unguided series here: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLZ1r83HxniSXUcxA2uRNHNWqyMDDRtUtZ&si=nNge3LpA1fqhdubt

RULES
- No use of OSRS wiki (or any equivalent) for anything - this includes looking up item spawns, quest guides, boss guides, anything
- No use of any other quest helper sites
- No use of quest helper plugin 
- Essentially no use of any outside-game assistance

CAVEATS
- I love OSRS YouTube, I might inadvertently learn something I don't know by watching my favourite content creators, but I'm not going to stop watching them so that's just a risk I'm willing to take + it's unlikely going to be relevant for me
- I may use some QoL plugins, but only a few. Loot tracker to prove grinds, ground items so I don't miss drops (and to add cool loot beams lol) and left click to use bones. Nothing that will give me info I didn't previously have
- I'm going to try and avoid any spoiler comments. If you can, please try not to help me if there's an episode where I'm stuck on something. I appreciate the sentiment but telling me an item spawn or quest step could spoil the fun :)

Music:
OSRS OST

#runescape #oldschoolrunescape #osrs #ironman #series

localized.title: The hunt for Runescape's most elusive animal
localized.description:
Forge Day PC Sale is Now Live! Starforge's Largest Sale of the Year! https://starforgepc.com/AlienFood #ad

Welcome to Unguided, where I'm trying to complete every quest in old school runescape without using a guide, wiki or plugins. I'll only be using my limited knowledge and in-game learnings. Full rules below.

Watch the full Unguided series here: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLZ1r83HxniSXUcxA2uRNHNWqyMDDRtUtZ&si=nNge3LpA1fqhdubt

RULES
- No use of OSRS wiki (or any equivalent) for anything - this includes looking up item spawns, quest guides, boss guides, anything
- No use of any other quest helper sites
- No use of quest helper plugin 
- Essentially no use of any outside-game assistance

CAVEATS
- I love OSRS YouTube, I might inadvertently learn something I don't know by watching my favourite content creators, but I'm not going to stop watching them so that's just a risk I'm willing to take + it's unlikely going to be relevant for me
- I may use some QoL plugins, but only a few. Loot tracker to prove grinds, ground items so I don't miss drops (and to add cool loot beams lol) and left click to use bones. Nothing that will give me info I didn't previously have
- I'm going to try and avoid any spoiler comments. If you can, please try not to help me if there's an episode where I'm stuck on something. I appreciate the sentiment but telling me an item spawn or quest step could spoil the fun :)

Music:
OSRS OST

#runescape #oldschoolrunescape #osrs #ironman #series
